description: Report a data problem you spotted (wrong price, dead tool, missing feature). Files it to the Toolradar verification queue. Use this when our data looks wrong so we can fix it: what Toolradar shows, what the vendor's own page says, and that page as evidence. A report on a tool and field that already has an open ticket is added to it; a pricing report also queues the tool's pricing page for a fresh read.

claim.description: What is wrong, and what it should be

evidence_url.description: A URL supporting the claim, ideally the vendor's own page (optional)

page_url.description: The page you were working on when you found it, e.g. the article being written (optional)

reporter.description: Who found it: your agent or workflow name (optional, 60 characters)

slug.description: The tool the issue is about

name: report_issue
